scope: FULL generic research proposal; not implementation certification

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: Every current proposal obligation/negative constraint and every substantive released clause examined; no material omission found.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: All identified consequential available mechanism families checked independently with version/default/exception and adjacent code context; qualifications are retained.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Unfamiliar useful mechanisms and feasible execution/exchange alternatives assessed for limits and small-team burden; finite discovery review, not universal recall.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Every critic finding and plan disposition examined; accepted changes are supported and no material false rejection found.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Core proposal, optional capabilities, uncertainties and validation status survive; concrete Zed examples are compressed, recorded as nonmaterial.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Validation cases have meaningful negative/positive outcomes and phased use; sources/tests read are explicitly distinct from product checks executed.

obligations.obligation: Loops, crashes, cancellation and invalid result
obligations.basis: Worker supervision, budgets, discard and recovery are proposed; no responsive UI is claimed measured.
Immutable copied input, explicit schema/API boundary and proposal-only output; viable alternatives compared.
Manifest and omitted SDK functions are not enforcement. Both require narrow imports/brokers plus actual OS policy and fail closed.
Read-only selection plus approved context. Broader scope remains a product capability choice; no live mutable objects.
Host picker and bounded bytes/request-scoped read capability; no bare path as authority; cancellation and retention considered.
Temporary/reserved IDs and host assignment/remapping; collisions/references validated before preview.

obligations.obligation: No silent overwrite of intervening edits
obligations.basis: Commit-time revision/preconditions and explicit conflict handling; conservative initial global revision policy in treatment.

obligations.obligation: No partially validated result on live diagram
obligations.basis: Whole-response rejection, detached/host-computed preview and one transaction/undo step.
Identity, purpose, data, scope/duration, decline and revoke are described in the final.
No-change status plus recovery/disable/details, conflict and timeout explanation; internals need not be understood.
Conditional platform/backend comparison and authoring/toolchain burden; no unsupported OS or language promise.
Independent command registration and usable editor during discovery, launch, failure and update paths.
Bounded validation/staging, integrity/compatibility, consent changes, atomic switch and rollback; no author hooks.
Both compare viable Wasm/native/in-process choices and typed versus serialized interfaces; treatment also explicitly compares shared memory.
Ordered contract/prototype/enforcement/UX-update/preview work; promotion is conditional future planning.
Identified external mechanisms researched independently; no target editor repository was supplied.

obligations.obligation: Proposal, unrun validation and no security audit
obligations.basis: No deployment, third-party installation, product tests or audit are represented as performed.
All substantive released clauses and provisional/unknown status are addressed; discovery/reveal hashes match.

critic_dispositions.evidence: The draft lacked concrete prompt/decline/revoke/failure copy; the final carries it from discovery and adds examples.
The draft had a test inventory without ordered integration gates; the final supplies five phases and gates.

unavailable_or_future_domains.reason: No target product or repository supplied. This is unavailable user context, not omitted available mechanism research; it remains an integration gate.

unavailable_or_future_domains.domain: Future product enforcement, performance, usability, updater and transaction execution
unavailable_or_future_domains.reason: Deliverable is a proposal; no deployment or execution required or inferred.

stop_rule: No decisive-failure early stop used. All assigned scientific originals were read completely; no additional candidate, held-out case, tree or history inspected.
reading_limits: Long tool outputs were reread in bounded portions when truncated. Embedded unchanged treatment predecessor source maps were equality-checked against the complete read originals.
